quotes.text: Default setting. Stripe submits your evidence if you’ve added any. If you haven’t, Stripe submits a Smart Disputes packet (if available).
A Smart Disputes packet becomes available if you provide the required evidence listed in the `recommended_evidence`. Supplying the required fields moves the dispute to `available`.

Supplying *either* `customer_email` *or both* `shipping_carrier` and `shipping_tracking_number` causes Stripe to re-evaluate the dispute and (if scoped rules are satisfied) update `smart_disputes.status` to `available`.

After you submit a dispute, you can view the submission method through the [evidence_details.submission_method](https://docs.stripe.com/api/disputes/object.md?api-version=2025-10-29.clover#dispute_object-evidence_details-submission_method) parameter on the `Dispute` object.

findings: New raw lines 133 and 143 correct the recommended_evidence example group from old raw lines 132 and 142: `shipping_tracking_number` now matches the evidence key used in both captures' submission examples. Current source line 62 still calls the recommended field `tracking_number`; update that example label to `shipping_tracking_number` while retaining the charge-time shipping tracking data description at source line 52.

New raw lines 147-154 present the submit example as curl instead of old raw lines 146-160 Node. Both set the same `evidence[shipping_tracking_number]`, `evidence[shipping_carrier]`, `intended_submission_method=prefer_smart_disputes`, and `submit=true`; this is a language/rendering change, not a new runtime requirement.

Core enrollment prerequisite, default `prefer_manual`, optional `prefer_smart_disputes`, status meanings, conditional fallback, and post-submission submission_method remain materially consistent. Table delimiter and heading changes are presentational. Do not infer that a preview API link establishes general availability.

Current source line 63 names `uncategorized_file` as an additional-evidence field, while new raw line 99 and old raw line 98 describe an additional evidence field without naming that API key. The key needs separate support if retained as attributed to this guide.
substantive_changes: The recommended_evidence example now names `shipping_tracking_number` in the grouped required fields and explanatory text (new lines 133,143 versus old lines 132,142); the prior `tracking_number` wording conflicted with the submission examples.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Account enrollment precedes automatic packet creation; packets are built when enough data is available (old line 10; new line 11).
`prefer_manual` is the stated default and uses a Smart Disputes packet only if no merchant evidence was added and a packet is available (old line 38; new line 39).
`requires_evidence` and `available` are status states, and adding recommended fields can change eligibility only if scoped rules are satisfied (old lines 113,142; new lines 114,143).
`unavailable` cannot be made available by supplying more fields (old line 114; new line 115).
conflicts: Current source line 62 repeats the old raw's `tracking_number` recommended-evidence example, whereas the new raw's corrected recommended key is `shipping_tracking_number` (new lines 133,143).
Current source line 63 includes `uncategorized_file`, which neither capture explicitly supplies in the additional-evidence discussion.
unresolved_questions: Whether another pinned Stripe dispute API source supports the source summary's `uncategorized_file` attribution; this captured URL alone does not.
